tools.name: Concept Studio OSM / Blender City Importer
useCases: Candidate city-context importer for manual evaluation
inputData: Seller-advertised OSM, SRTM, imagery and Google Photorealistic 3D paths
tools.licenseSummary: Paid add-on; delivered software/source license not inspected. Provider rights remain separate.
tools.exportGuidance: Evaluate an expressly reusable data path first. An importer purchase or API key does not authorize redistributing Google meshes.
limitations: No purchased archive, source audit, installation or independent benchmark.
The current listing also advertises an unnamed no-key photo-mesh source; its provenance and reuse permission remain unverified.

tools.name: Blosm base (formerly Blender-OSM)
tools.licenseSummary: Base download accepts zero payment; GPL source. Input datasets retain their own terms.
tools.exportGuidance: Prefer OSM and explicitly reusable terrain/municipal tiles for shipped assets; retain attribution and database obligations.
limitations: Base supports Google 3D Tiles too; it is not OSM-only.
OSM height/roof completeness varies; missing attributes do not become measured architecture.
Google availability, fees and restrictions still apply.

tools.name: Blosm Pro / Premium
tools.licenseSummary: Paid GPL-source add-on; bundled/external asset and provider terms must be retained.
tools.exportGuidance: Bake only materials and geometry whose licenses permit that output and redistribution.
limitations: OSM facade textures are generic, not photographs of each building.
Texture export is documented as experimental.
A texture-baking feature does not grant rights to restricted source tiles.

tools.name: BlenderGIS
tools.licenseSummary: GPL-3.0-or-later software; each imported dataset has separate rights.
tools.exportGuidance: Import reviewed local GIS files, preserve CRS/origin metadata, then export your prepared mesh with source credits.
limitations: Validate compatibility with the installed Blender version.
Online data providers have independent terms; OpenTopography needs an API key.
Georeferencing is not a survey-accuracy guarantee.

tools.name: QGIS
tools.licenseSummary: GPL software; dataset licenses remain independent.
tools.exportGuidance: Keep a GeoPackage/GeoTIFF source master plus CRS, vertical datum and transformation metadata; downstream mesh conversion is a separate step.
limitations: qgis_process and processing APIs are documented upstream; no new Daftar adapter is implied.
Processing plugins and algorithm versions must be pinned.
Assigning a CRS is different from transforming coordinates.

tools.name: GDAL / OGR
tools.licenseSummary: Primarily MIT source; optional dependencies and binaries may have other licenses.
tools.exportGuidance: Convert only approved input files; retain acquisition, CRS, resolution and license metadata beside outputs.
limitations: No Daftar integration or installation claimed.
Driver availability depends on build.
New unified CLI is version-sensitive; pin commands and versions before unattended use.

tools.name: PDAL
inputData: E57 and other supported point-cloud formats
tools.licenseSummary: BSD software; scan licenses are separate.
tools.exportGuidance: Keep original point-cloud provenance and classification; document filtering and transformations before meshing.
limitations: Documented pipelines are not an installed Daftar adapter.
Classification and scan accuracy require source review.
Point filtering alone does not create a textured game asset.

tools.name: Bonsai (formerly BlenderBIM)
tools.licenseSummary: GPL-3.0-or-later add-on. The building/model author's rights remain separate.
tools.exportGuidance: Keep IFC as the semantic master; derive a render/game mesh separately and retain element-to-asset IDs.
limitations: City photogrammetry does not automatically produce trustworthy IFC semantics.
Requires authoring and dimensional review.
BIM authoring capability does not certify a structural design.

tools.name: IfcOpenShell / IfcConvert
tools.licenseSummary: Core toolkit LGPL; Bonsai uses GPL. Check component and dependency licenses.
tools.exportGuidance: Export GLB for viewing while retaining IFC and IDs; explicitly record meter conversion and any coordinate offset.
limitations: GLB geometry is not a full replacement for IFC semantics.
Supported schemas/geometry vary by version.
No installed or registered runtime adapter is claimed.

tools.name: Cesium for Unreal
tools.licenseSummary: Apache-2.0 plugin. Unreal, Cesium ion and every dataset have separate terms.
tools.exportGuidance: Use streaming with the source's attribution/access controls. Export or self-host only datasets with explicit permission.
limitations: Plugin license does not license Google's content.
Streaming level of detail and collision need scenario testing.
ion access is separate from an installed plugin; no account was configured.

tools.name: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles
useCases: Attributed online geographic visualization, subject to the applicable agreement
tools.licenseSummary: Google Maps Platform agreement and Tile policies; paid usage/billing setup can apply.
tools.exportGuidance: Do not put downloaded Google mesh/texture files or baked derivatives in this reusable asset library without an express applicable license.
limitations: Personal or archviz intent is not a blanket exception.
Coverage, regional access, attribution and cache behavior require review.
API billing is separate from importer price; no key or account configured.

tools.name: OpenStreetMap data
tools.licenseSummary: ODbL: attribution and applicable database share-alike/access duties; output classification matters.
tools.exportGuidance: Track OSM-derived data separately, provide contributor/license credit, and review derived-database versus Produced Work obligations before publishing.
limitations: No guarantee of complete heights, roofs, interiors or global uniformity.
Public map tile servers prohibit bulk/prefetch use; obtain proper data extracts.
ODbL does not automatically require the entire game source to use ODbL.

tools.name: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 / GLO-90
tools.licenseSummary: Free-use dataset license with required source, modification and liability notices; EEA-10 has different access rights.
tools.exportGuidance: Use the license for the exact instance and carry its required notices into the derived terrain package.
limitations: DSM includes surface objects; it is not a bare-earth DTM.
Sampling cannot resolve building ornament or survey-level site details.
Access methods may require registration; no access configured.

tools.name: USGS 3DEP
tools.licenseSummary: USGS identifies 3DEP products as public domain; preserve source/metadata citations.
tools.exportGuidance: Prefer available project-quality terrain with verified datum/epoch; include original dataset identifiers in derived meshes.
limitations: Coverage, resolution and acquisition dates vary.
One-meter DEM availability is not universal.
DEM terrain does not provide facade/interior geometry.

tools.name: SRTM 1 Arc-Second Global
tools.licenseSummary: USGS-distributed open elevation product; retain NASA/USGS product citation and inspect delivery metadata.
tools.exportGuidance: Create regional terrain from the reviewed elevation grid; keep source resolution and EGM96 vertical datum recorded.
limitations: Near-global latitude coverage, not polar coverage; voids can remain.
Source acquisition was in 2000.
Thirty-meter sampling is unsuitable for fine architecture or current survey claims.

tools.name: 3DBAG
tools.licenseSummary: CC BY 4.0 data with specified creator credit, license link and modification notice.
tools.exportGuidance: Good candidate for permitted mesh conversion and game-context derivatives with retained attribution and change history.
limitations: Netherlands only.
LoD1.2/1.3/2.2 are city-model levels, not complete architectural interiors or ornaments.
Generated models and problematic-input fallbacks require local QA.

tools.name: Smithsonian Open Access 3D
tools.licenseSummary: Only assets explicitly designated CC0 receive the Open Access copyright waiver; other rights can remain.
tools.exportGuidance: Record the exact object's CC0 designation and source URL; keep scholarly credit even when not required.
limitations: A museum collection label does not establish every file's license.
Trademark, privacy/publicity or cultural restrictions may require separate review.
No asset downloaded or represented as cleared in this catalog.

tools.name: Open Heritage 3D
tools.licenseSummary: Creative Commons terms differ per dataset; many prohibit commercial use.
tools.exportGuidance: Approve the exact dataset license before processing; exclude non-commercial-only scans from commercial game distributions unless separately licensed.
limitations: Open access is not a universal commercial reuse grant.
Large raw scans need meshing, cleanup and validation.
Published research references do not automatically license underlying photos or meshes.

tools.name: Meshroom / AliceVision
inputData: Own or expressly licensed overlapping photographs
tools.licenseSummary: Meshroom MPL-2.0 software; plugins/dependencies and image/capture rights remain separate.
tools.exportGuidance: Generate a measured reconstruction, preserve capture/processing provenance, then retopologize and derive licensed game assets.
limitations: Release/plugin/hardware requirements must be reviewed before unattended use.
Unscaled reconstruction cannot establish real dimensions.
No reconstruction job or installation was performed.

tools.name: Google Research Open Buildings
inputData: Detected building polygons and confidence metadata
tools.licenseSummary: Choose CC BY 4.0 or ODbL under the published dual-license offer; record the selected license.
tools.exportGuidance: Use the separately licensed research dataset and its citation, not extracted Google Maps tiles.
limitations: Predicted footprints can contain omissions, false detections and shape errors.
Footprints are not measured heights, detailed facades or interiors.
Coverage and release must be checked for the target region.

tools.name: EOxCloudless imagery
useCases: Regional background imagery under vintage-specific terms
tools.licenseSummary: 2016 vintage: CC BY 4.0; newer public mosaics: non-commercial/share-alike or separate commercial license.
tools.exportGuidance: Record exact vintage and delivery terms before draping/exporting; retain required visible credit on media.
limitations: Do not transfer the 2016 license to a newer mosaic.
Public endpoint availability does not authorize unrestricted bulk redistribution.
This imagery is context, not facade-level architectural evidence.

tools.name: OGC 3D Tiles
useCases: Hierarchical streaming of licensed large 3D scenes
tools.licenseSummary: Open technical standard; each tileset's content license is independent.
tools.exportGuidance: An open container is not permission to cache, extract, rehost or redistribute its payload.
limitations: Renderer compatibility does not imply provider authorization.
Use self-owned or explicitly reusable tilesets for offline/export workflows.

claims.claim: Concept Studio OSM is a Blender city-import add-on.
claims.assessment: The Concept Studio seller page exists at the matching slug; its current title is Blender City Importer. This verifies the offering, not installed functionality.

claims.claim: Address/area selection imports Google 3D geometry, textures and streets.
claims.assessment: The creator advertises mapped selection and 3D import. Google's product is a textured mesh; visible streets are not thereby editable road networks. OSM is a distinct vector-derived path.

claims.claim: The import is georeferenced and correctly scaled.
claims.assessment: The creator describes precise coordinate handling. No independent control-point or dimensional test was performed; numeric placement precision does not establish source survey accuracy.

claims.claim: Automatic lighting and high/low-detail rings improve imports.
claims.assessment: The creator advertises scene-light response and distance-based detail controls. Their quality, savings and reproducibility remain untested here.

claims.claim: A full city block imports in under one minute or 60 seconds.
claims.assessment: No repeatable benchmark specifying area, detail, hardware, network and cold-cache state was established. A creator's real-time demonstration cannot guarantee arbitrary project latency.

claims.claim: Terrain comes from Google 3D Tiles rather than a DEM.
claims.assessment: That describes the photogrammetric mesh route. The product also advertises a separate SRTM elevation route; the claim does not describe every import mode.

claims.claim: Major cities are covered and rural areas are only 2D.
claims.assessment: Google describes photorealistic mesh coverage in many populated areas, not every city. The supplied urban/rural rule is too absolute; check the requested location and current product access.

claims.claim: Personal and archviz uses are usually fine; only commercial games need a terms check.
claims.assessment: The reviewed Google agreement does not establish that blanket exemption. Extraction, storage, derived-content and redistribution conditions depend on the implementation and applicable license, not merely its personal/archviz label.

claims.claim: CONCEPT50 offers 50% off the paid add-on.
claims.assessment: The current official seller page advertises that code and displays $49. This verifies advertised pricing only; the Instagram-bio placement, checkout eligibility, tax and successful redemption were not verified.

claims.claim: Related products exist for SketchUp, Unreal, Cinema 4D, Maya and 3ds Max.
claims.assessment: The creator storefront advertises those separate products. Feature parity, supported host versions and cross-product licensing were not tested.

claims.claim: Free Blosm uses OSM instead of Google and cannot import textured Google cities.
claims.assessment: The current free/base listing explicitly supports Google and other providers' 3D Tiles as well as OSM. Its untextured OSM mode must not be confused with its separate photogrammetric mode.

claims.claim: Blosm is free and works everywhere.
claims.assessment: The base add-on can be obtained for zero payment. Data completeness, provider costs/terms, regional Google restrictions and terrain coverage still vary; free software is not universal free data.

claims.claim: Blosm Premium textures reproduce the actual appearance of each OSM building.
claims.assessment: Pro documentation explicitly distinguishes its generic facade materials from actual per-building photographs.

claims.claim: A no-key photo-mesh source is automatically open and reusable.
claims.assessment: The current seller page advertises an additional no-key source without identifying its licensing in the reviewed text. No-key access alone establishes neither ownership nor export permission.

claims.claim: 3D Tiles, glTF, GPL software or an importer license makes downloaded content freely redistributable.
claims.assessment: Format, software and dataset rights are separate. Evaluate the actual payload license and service agreement before creating a distributable asset.

claims.claim: All open heritage scans can be shipped in commercial games.
claims.assessment: Open Heritage 3D licenses vary and many prohibit commercial use. Smithsonian's reuse offer applies to assets expressly marked CC0, with other rights still possible.
